methodology: 10 warmups, 30 samples, median of per-sample slowest-rank wall latency; source activation quantization included, weight preparation excluded. Nominal 8192/20480 tokens with the existing seeded variable-token routing workload. One comparison round; small margins are not a robust speed claim.
memory_scope: Requested live buffer sizes at the last measured step, maximum over ranks: native compute/communication pool + notify pool + FWD tensor storage + BWD tensor storage. Weight-cache table additionally counts all four FP8 matrices/scales or BF16 packed W1. Excludes shared BF16 master parameters, input X/dY, optimizer state, CUDA/NCCL context and allocator reserved memory. This is not a sampled GPU allocator peak.
